missing_pieces.duty: X-1: Write out every step owed by the stated results instead of deferring to a previous argument. In the annex proof of thm:p01-w02-p01-005-subset-algebra (handbook/annex/p01/sets-relations-functions-and-quotients-w02-p01-005.tex lines 296-297), the intersection operation G_cap is asserted to be a function from Q x Q to Q by 'The same argument with \cap and membership(2)'. For \cap, the proof must write the separation formula for the graph, show that each triple <<X,Y>,X\cap Y> lies in the bound (using X\cap Y in Q), and prove totality and single-valuedness through the ordered-pair identity. Likewise, the annex proof of thm:p01-w02-p01-005-membership clause 3 (lines 75-76) says 'The same argument with the formula x\notin B gives ...'. It must instead write the application of thm:p01-w02-p01-005-separated-set to the formula x\notin B (an L_in formula with parameter B, in which the formed variable is not free).
